Install prep

Get ready while it's on the way

A little prep now makes install day go smoother, whether your order is in transit or still being built.

Hero image
Prep scene: tape measure, pencil, level and stud finder beside an open installation guide on a work surface, a boxed Ekena piece in soft focus behind. No branded tools.

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, whether you're installing it yourself or handing it to a contractor, a little prep now saves time later. Every product page has the installation guide and specs for that piece. Start there, because the guide for your exact product beats any general advice.

Your prep checklist

1
Read the guide first
Note the recommended fasteners, adhesive and finishing steps.
2
Re-check your measurements
Measure the wall, ceiling or opening again and mark where each piece goes.
3
Know what's behind the surface
Find the studs, joists or solid backing and check the wall or ceiling structure before you mount anything.
4
Gather what the guide calls for
Have the recommended fasteners, adhesive and tools on hand before you start.
5
Dry-fit before you fasten
Set pieces in place to check fit and alignment.
6
Plan your finish
Priming, painting or staining? Follow the guide for your material.
